control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 % (dark), then if the line tracker reads below 90 % curve left, else if it reads above 95 % curve right, else call avoidWalls; if it is not dark, call avoidWalls.

avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 %, then if an obstacle is on the LEFT turn right 20°, else if an obstacle is on the RIGHT turn left 20°, else call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve (10 %, 40 %); otherwise curve (40 %, 10 %).
